summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe around grid construction labor productivity. The cleanest direct exposure is still contractors that own scarce lineworker capacity, but the more Serenity-relevant underfollowed lane is suppliers or platforms that can reduce crew hours, speed installation, or automate inspection. PLPC is the strongest underfollowed hypothesis because it sells transmission-line hardware installed by utilities and contractors, while external research claims its products may tie into robotic installation workflows. MYRG is a smaller direct labor-capacity owner versus Quanta. ONDS is a speculative micro-cap field-automation/drone candidate requiring proof of utility adoption.
